found: Writing %d of %d found, over all your runs.

legend.right: on a wall: step up to read it

warm.title: IN WICK'S HAND
warm.text: Lit every torch again, so the walls can see who comes. I owe them the light.

wary.title: SCRATCHED BY THE STAIR
wary.text: The halls moved while I slept. Same stones, new turns. The walls watched me wake.

cold.title: CARVED DEEP
cold.text: The gold was bait. I reached for it anyway. So did you. The walls saw us both.

warm.title: A TALLY, CROSSED OUT
warm.text: Someone struck out the tally and wrote: these sat with me instead. Count those.

wary.title: A CREW TALLY
wary.text: We all came for the gold. The ones who stopped laughing are in the wall now.

cold.title: A FRESH TALLY
cold.text: The newest marks are still wet, cut with an edge just like the one you carry.

warm.title: A BURROW DRAWING
warm.text: Drawn in slime: a dragon, a fire, and all of us safe behind it. It never looked back.

wary.title: A CREW LEDGER
wary.text: Snakes: nine, for sport. Rocks on our heads: eleven. Somebody up there hates us.

cold.title: CUT BY A FANG
cold.text: The Crew hunts us for sport. We keep the count. We are patient about the bill.

warm.title: A SMALLER HAND
warm.text: I am in this wall too. A little of me stayed lit. I light the others to say sorry.

wary.title: IN THE OLD STONE
wary.text: When the halls fold, we fall. We never mean it. The Crew is always underneath.

cold.title: WHAT THE DOOR SAYS
cold.text: Alone again. Fold the halls. Throw them back to the top. Let them try once more.

warm.title: ON THE LAST DOOR
warm.text: Names under the soot, two by two. Nobody who walked out of here walked out alone.

wary.title: VEXALITH'S CLAW
wary.text: I built this to catch the greedy, and a Door for two. I never had a second.

cold.title: BEHIND THE DOOR
cold.text: Every thief who came down alone is still here, folded into the walls, watching.
